role: I fixed these specifications after inspecting the historical ranking and before running these additions. This is not a prospective preregistration.
availability: I use exactly the latest 365 completed labels selected for each existing HAR forecast, including target_end == feature_cutoff and excluding unfinished targets.

rescaled_dvol.factor: arithmetic mean of each training label's realised variance divided by its raw DVOL variance
rescaled_dvol.forecast: factor times current raw DVOL variance
rescaled_dvol.floor: none; inputs and resulting forecast must be positive and finite

har_dvol_equal.forecast: 0.5 times existing HAR variance forecast plus 0.5 times raw DVOL variance
har_dvol_equal.weight_selection: I fixed the weight without examining this combination's outcomes. The HAR component still has estimated coefficients.

cohort: I retain every original matched origin and report every declared row, regardless of its ranking.
inference: I reuse the parent plan's paired stationary bootstrap, seed, block sensitivities, HAC and ESS machinery. All intervals remain descriptive.
in_sample_scale_check: I report the full-sample scalar QLIKE optimum as an algebraic diagnostic only, separately from the completed-label rolling forecasts.
annual: I report calendar-year counts, paired mean QLIKE differences and signed sums. The final year is partial. A signed contribution share can exceed 100 percent when other years offset it.
prospective_scope: I leave the locked prospective primary comparison, model set and stopping rules unchanged.
optional_extensions: I defer log-variance HAR and ETH to a later version.
